title: What a Place Holds — VSG at Swab Barcelona
description: Virtual Studio Groups takes part in Swab Barcelona 2026 within Porous Practices, the project CasCaDas ArtSpace presents in OFF-Site, the fair's programme for independent art spaces. Fifteen works that take their material from a site, stay with one place for years, or use space nobody built for art. Reached by QR code from Stand OFF3 and open to everyone online.

title: Works Beyond the Walls — VSG at TRYST Art Fair
description: VSG participates in TRYST, the world's largest international art fair dedicated to artist-run spaces, collectives, and independent organizations. Our presentation includes a hybrid exhibition: physical works in the booth alongside an online component showing works by artists who could not travel.

title: El agua nos llama — VSG Group Exhibition
description: The first exhibition of Virtual Studio Groups artists in Spain. Fifteen artists, fifteen relationships with water — sculpture, photography, installation, collage, and painting.

title: Dreams — VSG Group Exhibition
description: A collective wall of dream images. Twenty-one artists contributed square-format works that together form a shared interior landscape.

title: VSG at Supermarket Art Fair
description: VSG participated in Supermarket Art Fair Stockholm, the independent art fair for artist-run spaces and projects.
